green.scope: Combined third-batch source/app/integrate fixtures at light1440/dark390 in the actual owned iframe. Real File/JSZip decompression, SVG arrows, composite and emoji rendering, 3/34-child Org Chart layouts with 4/35 segments and no geometric jumps, nested-parent layout, explorer close, actual SQL popup inputs and resulting PK/FK cells. Update POST and replay scheduled delay use controlled substitutes. All pageerrors[]. Screenshot inspected.
green.limits: Standalone SQL/Update/Replay assets are dynamically loaded; tested against each runtime, not claimed to be separate compiled copies. Straight duplicate arrow-point cases tested; no physical printer, external POST or wall-clock replay.

green.scope: Eight assets parse and match pinned sync, byte-identical outside reviewed functions: app6/integrate12/shapes4/core2/viewer6/viewer-static10/orgchart2/extensions2.

securityReview: ZIP compressed size checked before JSZip; entry count checked after directory parsing. Metadata and actual decompression bytes are both checked; stream paused and buffered parts released on excess. Exactly one entry chosen per archive; total expanded payload is at most8MiB. File transfer/download limits are unchanged.
Unsupported or cross-origin automatic Update destinations are rejected before getGraphXml/XML serialization. Same-origin payload still reaches the controlled request sink.
SysML self-inclusion is skipped and later valid symbols can still paint; BPMN and emoji require own keys.
Segment sets are copied when assigned to points, preventing merges from modifying original segment identity sets; temporary point marks retain existing cleanup.
No real credentials, production data, paid models or external request receivers.
notRun: Full Aide workbench, physical printer, connected cloud/file services.
Windows/macOS native/device acceptance; this cycle changes JavaScript only.
All Org Chart strategies and arbitrary SQL dialect grammar; scoped cases are recorded above.
